comparison.objective: Index a cryogenic canister beneath a dewar shoulder; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Canister transport and indexed placement versus tool insertion, rotational adjustment, counterholding, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Canister placed at the marked dewar position versus repeated stops within physical energy, stroke, rebound, overload, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: The indexed pick-and-place ability is meaningfully different from mechanical tuning and locking.
